name: OTEL Trace Port Registration
description: Window registration process for receiving trace data via MessagePorts

scenarios.description: Window successfully registered a MessagePort to receive trace data from collector

template.introduction:
**MessagePort Registered**

Window `{{window.id}}` successfully registered to receive traces from source `{{source.url}}`.

The window will now receive real-time trace batches via MessagePort IPC.

template.summary:
**Registration Details:**
- Window ID: `{{window.id}}`
- Source URL: `{{source.url}}`
- Port Key: `{{port.key}}`
- Subscribers: {{subscribers.count}}

**IPC Setup:**
1. Renderer invoked `otel-collector:registerPort`
2. Main process created MessageChannelMain
3. Port1 registered with collector service
4. Port2 transferred to renderer via postMessage
5. Preload bridge set up port.onmessage listener
6. Subscriber callback registered

**MessagePort Flow:**
```
Renderer (registerPort)
    | [IPC invoke]
Main Process (create MessageChannel)
    | [port1 -> collector]
Collector (stores port for routing)
    | [port2 -> renderer via postMessage]
Preload (port.onmessage listener)
    | [callback on message]
Subscriber (receives trace batches)
```

**What Happens Next:**
- Collector will route matching traces to this port
- Subscriber callbacks invoked on each TRACE_BATCH message
- Port remains active until window closes or unregisters
